items.summary: 06.02.01 and 06.02.03 rendered the safeguarding vetting signal as a 'badge' with status grammar ('DBS checked, current'), contradicting 06.02.02 D-11/D-02/DT-07 — the file that owns the credential block and its rendering. Rewrote all six drifted locations to state the dated-statement form and cited 06.02.02 D-11 / D-02 inline, and added the missing rendering seam to both consumers' cross-cut notes.
items.canonicalSource: 06.02.02-verified-credentials-credit-backed-credibility.md:313 (D-11) — "Vetting renders as a **dated statement naming the check and its jurisdiction**, never as a badge, tick or shield | Per DT-07 and DT-10. The fact is a snapshot with no legal expiry; a tick asserts a current status the platform cannot possess, and implies a safety assessment the check never made. The date is the honesty." Reinforced by 06.02.02:304 (D-02) "no composite trust score, **no summary badge, no headline count**"; 06.02.02:161 "No green tick. No shield. No word \"safe\"."; 06.02.02:270 (DT-07) "❌ REJECTED, and this is the most dangerous design in the file ... **A tick is status grammar; the fact is a snapshot.**". Ownership seam asserted from the owning side at 06.02.02:285 ("Consumes **Safeguarding & Minor Protection** ... Owned there; **gated** at 06.01.04; **displayed** here. Three different files, deliberately.") and 06.02.02:289 ("Touches **06.02.01 Teacher & Tuition Profile** — renders inside it, but is not authorable by it (D-01, CX-02)"). Parent index concurs: 06.02-teacher-discovery-profiles-trials-index.md:41 "**Never a badge** — 06.02.02 D-02 bans a composite trust score, a summary badge and a headline count".
items.classificationRationale: One side is a numbered, ratified decision in the file that owns the concept, backed by a three-part Deep Think rejection (DT-07), a second decision banning the same grammar for every other evidence kind (D-02), an explicit gated-vs-displayed ownership seam (06.02.02:285), and the parent index restating it verbatim. The other side is incidental worked-example wording inside decisions whose actual subject is something else — 06.02.01 D-09 rules on publication *tier*, not rendering form, and 06.02.03 D-03 rules that vetting *gates rather than ranks* and says nothing about how it renders. Neither consumer carries any decision authorising a badge. No product behaviour was invented: every replacement restates D-11's own four-part form (check, jurisdiction, date, plain sentence) or D-02's prohibition.

The replacement worked example is lifted from 06.02.02:157, not invented. Table row: 3 pipes preserved.
3. Line 212 (CX-M31 cross-cut note) — "the composition of vetting badges for a logged-out parent" → "how the vetting statement composes for a logged-out parent — a statement, per 06.02.02 D-11, never a badge".
4. Line 222 (06.02.02 cross-cut note) — added the missing rendering seam the verifier flagged: "**Rendering grammar is 06.02.02's, not this page's**: the profile owns the tier a credential is published at (D-09), never the form it takes. Vetting is a dated statement naming the check and its jurisdiction (06.02.02 D-11); no evidence kind is ever a badge, tick, shield, summary label or count (06.02.02 D-02)."

06.02.03-teacher-discovery-match-criteria.md:
5. Happy Path step 5 (was line 162) — "a vetting badge" → "the vetting item in 06.02.02 D-11's form (the check named with its jurisdiction and its date, never a badge, tick or shield)".
6. Edge case "Search index is stale by minutes" (line 198) — "Nobody sees a stale vetting badge" → "Nobody sees a stale vetting statement — and because it is a dated statement rather than a badge (06.02.02 D-11), even a stale one names the date it speaks for". Table row: 4 pipes preserved.
7. Populated state (line 224) — "vetting badge" → "the vetting item in 06.02.02 D-11's form — the named check, its jurisdiction and its date, never a badge, tick or shield". Table row: 4 pipes preserved.
8. Stale state (line 230) — "No stale badge is ever rendered" → "No stale vetting statement is ever rendered — and there is no badge to go stale in the first place (06.02.02 D-11)". Table row: 4 pipes preserved.
9. 06.02.02 cross-cut note (line 271) — added the missing rendering seam: "**The result card renders the evidence, but 06.02.02 owns its grammar** — this feature decides which teachers appear and in what order; it never decides what a signal *looks like*. That matters most for vetting: on a card it is the dated statement 06.02.02 D-11 specifies, never a badge, tick or shield, because a compact surface is exactly where the temptation to compress a snapshot into a status is strongest, and 06.02.02 DT-07 calls that the most dangerous design in the sub-domain. Same rule for credits: no summary badge, no headline count (06.02.02 D-02)."
items.notFixed: Three surviving occurrences of the word 'badge' in these files were deliberately left alone because each is a prohibition or an unrelated UI noun, not a rendering of the safeguarding signal: 06.02.01:149 ("no public shaming, no \"expired\" badge to a stranger"), 06.02.01:246 (D-14, "the stranger sees no badge of shame"), and 06.02.03:202 ("Shown, ranked normally, with no special badge" — an existing-teacher marker). None asserts a badge exists.
items.residue: One presentational detail D-11 leaves under-determined and this remediation deliberately did not decide: whether a compact result card carries D-11's fourth element — the plain sentence of what the check does and does not mean — or only the check, jurisdiction and date with the sentence on the profile. Both edits cite D-11's form by reference rather than asserting an abbreviated card variant, so no product behaviour was invented either way. This is a layout question for `/create-prd-design-system`, not a spec contradiction, and it does not reopen the badge question — DT-07 forecloses the compressed form regardless of surface.
items.verification: Re-read every changed line. All eight markdown table blocks across both files pass a pipe-count-per-block check (no column drift). All remaining badge/tick/shield mentions in both files are prohibitive. No edit was made to the canonical source 06.02.02, to the parent index, or to any file outside this shard.
